listing.name: Mega Man Legends — MegaManLegendsRecomp (VuloB1)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream native title enhancements, terrain-edge white-line defect and no shipped HDpack; no complete campaign claim established. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA MegaManLegends disc; exact serial/revision requires game.toml/DISC readback rather than inherited framework profile.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local owned-input source route: initialize pinned submodules, regenerate gameC with the documented psxrecomp_cli.py generate command from the owned MegaManLegends disc, then CMake/Ninja psx-runtime. Keep local generation private; publishing is not part of setup. Upstream release/launcher packages remain uninspected and unqualified.

warnings: Upstream native title enhancements, terrain-edge white-line defect and no shipped HDpack; no complete campaign claim established.
